I started using it about a year ago, and I really don’t have time to say all the things I like about it, but here’d an overview of why I highly value and appreciate it : 

-singleness of purpose: don’t get me wrong, there are other wonderful prayer apps, some of which I also use and recommend, but the simple design and effectiveness of focusing on Novenas only had the biggest impact on developing a regular prayer life at a time when I was struggling to pray 

- Getting to know the Saints…there is a patron saint for pretty much any struggle you’re facing or intention you have: the bio of the Saints are very well written and show these were real people who had fascinating lives

-keeps track of what day you’re on…after you pray, you clink a button to indicate you’ve finished praying for that day and the app tracks the last time you prayed the novena, and what day you’re on

-the daily prayers are typically pretty short, but usually quite uplifting and motivating…through this app I have developed a deep desire to become a saint, not because I think I’m holier than the average person, but because I have become convinced we are all called to be Saints.
